notes.title: Nayla's Fable: Lust and Rust OUT NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391270/Naylas_Fable_Lust__Rust/
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/7c987eb64d8a4c2ec473251d079ff19f69387eed.png
Nayla's Fable: Lust & Rust is out now! Nayla's an energetic girl who got a part-time job at Sunstone Power Plant, Everything was going perfectly during her first day at work, when she stumbled upon an underground forgotten lab and accidentally released a strange substance with some "serious" aphrodisiac effect. 
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/1b1acd340e09b1c18df825b5b705550c0838b144.png
Scared to reveal her mistake and get fired, she decides to looks for a solution by herself, with the assistance of a new unexpected friend.

Help Nayla investigate and look for resources while completing her daily work schedules and find a solution to this experimental substance before it's spreads everywhere and affect the entire power plant!
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/990b01414d2869b44c44aa6d0b6549c74d143115.gif
- A short adventure with a short stacked hottie
- Various minigames to keep you engaged between sex scenes
- Full graphic adventure mechanics for an interactive story
- Animated sex scenes giving each scene some extra spice
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391270/Naylas_Fable_Lust__Rust/

notes.title: Deathblight Jormungandr Announced!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468280/Deathblight_Jormungandr/

The Goddess of Mischief, Loki ventures out to explore and conquer the marshland and its inhabbitants for her own machinations. 

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/e4ac44052f3fbe5d940ad1923bcd2e5dece5e8e3.png

Upon entering the cursed lands, she finds her powers seriously weakened, and the creatures of the swamp to be uncooperative and even hostile.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/25e848bbdb65900d4a9a70f4a873e3e612f289b6.png

Can Loki beat sense into the goblin tribes and transform the malediction into a power of her own?

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d00a391ca9a73138630230178a40fce4aec2c728.png

- A very VERY difficult, unusual RPG Maker meets turn-based combat!

- Complex combat system that punishes skill spam

- Enemies that can telegraph their attacks

- Loki needs to use smart tactical counter-attacks based on the situation

- No grinding (you can avoid unnecessary fights)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468280/Deathblight_Jormungandr/

notes.title: Pyramid Tits DLC & Easter Events!!!
notes.content:
Happy April 1st everyone! This one is going to be a crazy update for Shady Lewd Kart. As its the day of fools we decided to release some content that was lost and forgotten in the early days of Kart. Pyramid Tits was a lost character from the early concept of Kart that parodies a certain raider of tombs. Well now you can play as her in our first official DLC!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579600/Shady_Lewd_Kart__Pyramid_Tits_Character_Pack/
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/9bb4a9a3116794c4d93044d9a5c9b4e863882daa.png
PT has a full story mode and three unlocks including her damage bubble and panties to collect as well as she is voiced by british babe PixieWillow! So you know its a banger of an update!

Also for your pleasure ALL the Easter Events are back. Every single one! So get out there if you havent and collect those goodies! Lots of characters and lewds to collect!

We also did some polishing of a few things as well as the main loading times for the game so lets see how that feels on your gunked up computer! As always let us know what you think and any bugs keep us informed.

Happy April Fools!

- Shades
